hero.filename: Cityscape and skyline by the Copenhagen Lakes, Denmark - (36018109956).jpg
hero.caption: Taken in front of the iconic neon lights over the lakes (søerne) in Copenhagen, Denmark. The Irma Block (Danish: Irma Karréen) on Sortedam Dossering, a street that follows the western shore of Sortedam Lake in Copenhagen. The Irma Hen (Irmahønen) is Denmark's oldest neon sign.
